verdict.rationale: First-party docs say every cloud browser runs in a hardened Chromium fork with stealth on by default and no configuration needed. They also say residential proxies are on by default across 195+ countries, alongside managed proxy support, which covers both the stealth and the residential/geo-proxy parts of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how to choose a target country or region (or bring your own proxy), details of what the stealth fingerprinting changes, and independent or hands-on confirmation that it avoids bot detection.
